name: Plugin Reference
description: Provides a field that stores a soft reference to a plugin
project_description:
This module provides a " Plugin reference " field that allows to create soft references to plugins.

 This module was created to allow to create relationships between entities and plugins in a simple way. The aim of these relationships is usually to perform background actions against the entity using the selected plugin.

 Usage 
 This module provides a new field type that can reference a plugin.

 Usage is straightforward. You only need to create a new field of type " Plugin reference " for your entity and configure it in the same way you do for other field types.
